title: Event Sourcing for an Inventory Availability Solution
summary: Avoids flash-sale row-lock contention by appending reservation events under a unique SKU-location sequence number.

title: CarbonJ: A high performance, high-scale, drop-in replacement for carbon-cache and carbon-relay
summary: Replaces Graphite's whisper files, whose random per-metric writes maxed out SSD I/O, with CarbonJ on embedded RocksDB.

title: How to ETL at Petabyte-Scale with Trino
summary: Works around Trino's lack of mid-query fault tolerance by running Huron's ETL as short INSERTs, cheap to retry.

title: Evolution of Region Assignment in the Apache HBase Architecture — Part 3
summary: Stops duplicate region transitions after server crashes by letting one TransitRegionStateProcedure own each region.

title: Evolution of Region Assignment in the Apache HBase Architecture — Part 2
summary: Makes region transitions survive crashes and avoid collisions with logged ProcedureV2 steps under hierarchical locks.

title: Evolution of Region Assignment in the Apache HBase Architecture — Part 1
summary: Traces stuck HBase 1 assignments to multi-writer region state synced via ZooKeeper, which AMv2 gives a single writer.

title: Coordinated Rate Limiting in Microservices
summary: Holds per-tenant API limits steady as instances scale by counting locally in Caffeine and syncing deltas to Redis.

title: The Design of Strongly Consistent Global Secondary Indexes in Apache Phoenix — Part 2
summary: Stops racing updates from duplicating index rows without deadlock by freeing locks before index RPCs and caching state.

title: The Design of Strongly Consistent Global Secondary Indexes in Apache Phoenix — Part 1
summary: Keeps index tables on other servers consistent with data by writing index rows unverified first and repairing on read.

title: Optimizing EKS networking for scale
summary: Avoids VPC subnet exhaustion from idle warm-pool IPs on EKS nodes by lowering WARM_IP_TARGET and WARM_ENI_TARGET.

title: Hadoop/HBase on Kubernetes and Public Cloud (Part II)
summary: Fixes PDB-blocked StatefulSet upgrades with a custom controller and Hadoop IP caching with a Service per metadata pod.

title: Hadoop/HBase on Kubernetes and Public Cloud (Part I)
summary: Limits an upgrade or AZ outage to one HDFS replica with a DataNode StatefulSet per AZ and an AZ topology script.

title: Global Synchronousness and Ordering in Delta Lake
summary: Ends Conflicting Commits errors among Spark streams on a Delta table with a ZooKeeper lock and predecessor check.

title: Engagement Activity Delta Lake
summary: Fixes slow mutations that hit many date partitions by partitioning engagement data by org alone, Z-ordered by date.
